bettertyping.name: Better Typing
bettertyping.settings.spell_check.descri: Underline misspelled words in red. Put the cursor on one and press Tab for suggestions.
bettertyping.settings.autocomplete.descr: Suggest words while you type. Tab picks one, Space takes it.
bettertyping.settings.undo_redo.descript: Undo and redo in every text field, with the shortcuts below.
bettertyping.settings.shortcut.undo.desc: Undoes the last word, deletion, paste or accepted suggestion.
bettertyping.settings.shortcut.redo.desc: Brings back what undo took away.
Redo also works with this one, like Ctrl+Y in most programs.
bettertyping.settings.shortcut.key.descr: Letters and digits follow your keyboard layout. Tab, Space, Enter and Escape are taken.
bettertyping.settings.language.descripti: The language spell check and autocomplete use. Game language follows the game's language when its words are installed, and English (US) otherwise. Picking a language marked "download" fetches it from GitHub when you press Save.
bettertyping.settings.personal_dictionar: Words that are never underlined. "Add to dictionary" in the spelling list puts words here.
